correctness.rationale: For all real six coefficients with b4 != 0, the actual RESULT.md defines P=z-b3*y-b2*x-(b7/2)*x^2-b8*x*y and derives L_F P=b4*x^2+(b5-b8)*y^2. I independently differentiated this polynomial using SymPy (zero residual). If b4*(b5-b8)>=0, sP is bounded and monotone on a bounded forward orbit; its compact omega-limit has constant P, hence x=0, and invariance of xdot=y,ydot=z forces the origin. For a bounded complete orbit, alpha and omega limits both origin and monotonicity eliminates nontrivial heteroclinic/homoclinic trajectories. Integrating the Lie derivative under compact invariant mu gives the exact second-moment ratio; on the closed sector x=0 mu-a.e., invariance forces delta at zero. The opposite-sign coefficients b2=-omega^2,b3=b5=b7=0,b8=-beta yield an invariant plane z=-omega^2*x, harmonic cycles at every R>0 with omega^2=-b4/beta. No claim made for arbitrary unbounded initial values, or for existence at every opposite-sign parameter.

value.rationale: This is a natural coefficient-uniform obstruction problem for the six-parameter family used to produce nine nonhyperbolic numerical chaotic models. The closed sign cone rigorously excludes all compact recurrence, including its boundary, and the explicit opposite-sign harmonic family proves sharp uniform possibility; the stationary second-moment balance gives a new diagnostic for candidate recurrent states. This is structural information not a textbook restatement of local eigenvalues or isolated finite calculation.
